pictures.name: CST1-Women-Spices
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Before dawn on a rocky path outside ancient Jerusalem, olive trees and stone terraces. In the middle, three women: Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with long dark hair under a deep red mantle; Joanna, a woman in a blue-grey veil and a finer embroidered robe; and an older woman, Mary the mother of James, in a brown shawl, walk close together carrying small clay jars and cloth bundles of spices, faces tired with grief. The sky deep blue with the first pale gold line of dawn on the horizon. Quiet sorrow, love, faithfulness. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CST2-Who-Will-Roll
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same three women on the path at dawn, seen closer: three women: Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with long dark hair under a deep red mantle; Joanna, a woman in a blue-grey veil and a finer embroidered robe; and an older woman, Mary the mother of James, in a brown shawl. They have stopped; the older woman gestures ahead with worry, Mary Magdalene looks up the path with her jar held to her chest. Ahead, in the distance, a rock-cut garden tomb with a huge round stone. Deep blue morning shadows, first gold light. Worry, determination. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CST3-Stone-Moved
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A rock-cut tomb in a garden at sunrise, its huge round stone rolled aside, the dark doorway open and empty, folded linen glimpsed inside on a stone ledge. In the foreground three women: Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with long dark hair under a deep red mantle; Joanna, a woman in a blue-grey veil and a finer embroidered robe; and an older woman, Mary the mother of James, in a brown shawl, stand frozen in amazement, jars lowered, one hand at a mouth. Gold sunrise light pouring across the rock and the open door in the middle. Astonishment, a dawning hope. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CST4-Two-Men-Shining
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside the entrance of the empty rock tomb: two tall shapes of pure dazzling white light, like standing flames of brightness, no faces, no wings, no human features, glow beside the empty stone ledge with folded linen. Before them three women: Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with long dark hair under a deep red mantle; Joanna, a woman in a blue-grey veil and a finer embroidered robe; and an older woman, Mary the mother of James, in a brown shawl, bow low in awe and fear. The white light of the two bright shapes in the middle, deep blue shadow in the rock, gold dawn behind the women. Awe, wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CST5-Tell-Apostles
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A plain upper room in Jerusalem in morning light. Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with long dark hair under a deep red mantle, stands in the middle, breathless, hands open, telling the news; Joanna and the older woman in a brown shawl stand beside her nodding. A group of tired bearded men in rough tunics sit and stand around, some doubtful, one frowning, one slowly rising to his feet. Gold light through a small window, deep blue shadows. Urgent joy meeting doubt. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CST6-Today-Easter-Morning
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern Easter Sunday morning, painted in the same sacred oil style: a family of three generations walks out of a stone church into bright spring sunshine, white lilies by the doors, a little girl in a yellow dress holding her grandmother’s hand, church bells overhead. Behind them, through the open doors, the tall Easter candle glows near the altar. Warm gold morning light, deep blue shade under blossoming trees. The family in the middle. Joy, new life. No text, no letters, no logos.
